## Walkcast 0.10.5

### Launch Studio rendering

- Run the procedural score generator with Python, not Node.
- Split the narration stream for music ducking and the final audio mix.
- Reuse a complete local Kokoro model cache and stop generation early with a clear message when the model still needs setup.
- Keep site-specific names in the film graphics instead of feeding unknown domains to Kokoro's English phonemizer.
- Preserve renderer diagnostics in Launch Studio when a child process fails.
